create_local_scenario_iterator: create a CountableIterator that loads benchmark scenarios from a local dataset directory with optional config and split filters
iterate_local_scenarios_with_limit: iterate over benchmark scenarios from a local dataset directory limited to a maximum number of scenarios
load_scenarios_with_completed_events: load benchmark scenarios from a local dataset with their completed events for offline validation
load_scenarios_concurrently: load benchmark scenarios from a local dataset directory using concurrent threads with a progress bar
filter_scenarios_by_config_and_split: load benchmark scenarios filtered by config subdirectory and split subdirectory from a local dataset path
